description: This file defines the ImageResizeTagHelper class, which is a Razor Tag Helper for resizing images in an ASP.NET Core application. It processes image attributes, generates resized image URLs, and optionally adds security tokens.

classes.name: ImageResizeTagHelper
classes.description: A Razor Tag Helper for dynamically resizing images based on specified attributes, generating URLs with resize parameters, and optionally securing URLs with tokens.

methods.name: ProcessAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the image tag, constructs the resized image URL, and updates the 'src' attribute.
